reviews.title: Beautiful, functional, perfect.
reviews.comment: This case is absolutely beautiful and was incredibly easy to build in. I had a ton of fun building an ITX gaming powerhouse with this case. Yes, it's small and you have to consider heat, but due to the metal frame and tons of slots it actually radiates heat really well. I've been running a high end AM4 build with a 5600X CPU and an RTX 4070S GPU. I can play flagship games at 4k120 no problem without getting throttled by temps. This case was designed with so much care, they considered every possible build that could fit in there, and it really shows when you go to build in it.
reviews.author: TheGeekFreak

reviews.title: Very nice, very small case
reviews.comment: This is a very nice ITX case.  Access is easy, with a removable top and both sides swing fully open.  Keep in mind this is a very small case that requires planning to ensure everything fits.  Build quality is high.  I really like the adjustable plate inside that allows more space for either GPU or CPU cooling.
